meaning.en: The sound of the universe. Feel it vibrate gently in your chest; babies can feel it too.
meaning.hinglish: Brahmand ki dhvani. Chhaati mein iski halki goonj mehsoos karein; baby bhi mehsoos karta hai.

devanagari: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः । तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं । भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
transliteration: Om bhur bhuvah svah, tat savitur varenyam, bhargo devasya dhimahi, dhiyo yo nah prachodayat

meaning.en: May the bright light of the sun awaken and guide our minds.
meaning.hinglish: Suraj ki pavitra roshni hamari buddhi ko jagaaye aur raah dikhaaye.

devanagari: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥
transliteration: Om tryambakam yajamahe sugandhim pushtivardhanam, urvarukam iva bandhanan mrityor mukshiya mamritat

meaning.en: A prayer to Shiva for health, strength and peace for the whole family.
meaning.hinglish: Poore parivaar ki sehat, shakti aur shaanti ke liye Shiv ki prarthana.
